author: Bellular News
description:
Discord's new age checks have locked adults out of servers while the company tests FanDuel ads using age signals. We look at what went wrong, why Discord wants to get ahead of new laws, and whether better features can win back users before its planned IPO.

Join us at https://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
